title: Greetings
label: ch:greetings
canDo: I can greet, thank, and take my leave in Hindi, and write by hand the first Devanagari letters those words are built from.

payoff.summary: Greet, thank formally and casually, and take a weighty leave in Hindi from memory; name each word's heritage; then write न, म, क and त by hand, body first and bar last, and say what orders the stop families along the mouth.
payoff.note: HI-C01-practice is the chapter's last lesson (sequence 100, after the writing ramp), so it now carries the payoff and assesses all fifteen atoms the chapter introduces: the five greeting words and their two heritages, plus a hand-written न म क त and spoken recall of the head-line, the shared spine frame, the inherent vowel and the mouth-ordered stop families.
